title: rust-view report
description: Static metrics for a cargo workspace. Paths are relative to the workspace root and `/`-separated. Test code is `#[cfg(test)]` items, `#[test]` fns, and files under `tests/`. Every per-file metric except `lines.test` and `tests` excludes test code.

version.description: Schema version. Bumped on any breaking change.

path.description: Package directory; `.` for a root package.

packages.description: Resolved dependency graph: the crate itself and every package it transitively depends on, sorted by name then version. Empty if the dependencies could not be resolved.

dependency.description: A dependency declared in the package's Cargo.toml. A `path` dependency whose name matches another entry in `crates` is workspace-internal.

req.description: Version requirement as written (workspace-inherited values resolved); null if none.

package.description: A resolved package, identified by `name` and `version`.

dependencies.description: Resolved dependencies, one entry per package and kind. Each names another entry in `packages`. Only workspace members have `dev` entries.

totals.description: Per-file metrics summed field by field.

path.description: Unique across the report; the key that `root` and the `file` fields in `imports`, `reexports`, and `flows` refer to.

module.description: Module path of the file within its target, rooted at `crate`.

root.description: `path` of the root file of the target the file belongs to. Module paths are unique within a target, not within a crate.

definitions.description: Named items in source order. Empty for a test file.

flows.description: Data flow through the file's fns and conversion impls, in source order, then through the channel ends its types' fields hold. Empty for a test file.

lines.description: Disjoint line counts; their sum is the total line count.

doc.description: Lines holding only doc comments or `#[doc = ..]` attributes, in test code or not.

combinators.description: Iterator/Option/Result adapter calls (`map`, `filter`, `fold`, `and_then`, ...), matched by method name.

higher_order_fns.description: Fn definitions that take or return a function (`Fn*` bound, `impl`/`dyn Fn*`, or fn pointer).

definition.description: A named item outside test code and outside fn bodies. Modules, `impl` blocks, and methods are not listed.

module.description: Absolute path of the module defining the item: the file's `module`, extended by any inline modules around the item.

public.description: Has a visibility modifier (`pub`, `pub(crate)`, ..); for a macro, `#[macro_export]`.

import.description: An intra-crate dependency of the file: `use` declarations (`pub use` included) and qualified paths starting with `crate`, `self`, or `super`. One entry per target module; same-file targets are omitted.

module.description: Absolute path of the deepest module the import path resolves to. Re-exports are not followed; see `reexports`.

file.description: `path` of the file defining that module.

names.description: Imported names, sorted and deduplicated. `*` for a glob; empty if only the module itself is imported.

reexport.description: One name re-exported by a `pub use` in the file (restricted visibilities such as `pub(crate)` included), traced back to its definition. A glob has name `*` and a single hop to the globbed module.

name.description: Name as exported, after any `as` rename.

trace.description: Hops from this re-export toward the definition, nearest first. Each intermediate hop is itself a re-export.

end.description: How the trace ends. `definition`: the last hop's module defines the item. `external`: the last hop is outside the crate. `unresolved`: the name was not found in the last hop's module (e.g. macro-generated).

flow.description: A fn, a conversion impl, or a field holding a channel end, and the types whose values pass through it. A fn or method outside fn bodies is listed if its signature names a type; a `From`, `TryFrom`, or `Into` impl if both its ends do. A type is a struct, enum, or union of the crate, or a type outside it named through a `use` or a qualified path; primitives, prelude types, and type parameters are left out. Aliases are expanded. `Result`, `Option`, `Vec`, `Box`, `Rc`, `Arc`, `Pin`, `Poll`, references, pointers, slices, arrays, and tuples stand for the types inside them, as `Receiver<T>` does for `T`.

name.description: The fn, as `Type::method` for a method; the trait for a conversion impl; `Type.field` for a field, with the variant between them in an enum. Not unique: two impls can give a type the same method.

module.description: The file's module, extended by any inline modules around the flow.

kind.description: `fn`: a fn or method. `convert`: a conversion impl, from its source to its target. `field`: a field holding a `Sender<T>`, from its type to `T`, or a `Receiver<T>`, from `T` to its type.

inputs.description: The types of the parameters. One taken by `&mut` is changed in place, so values pass into it too.

outputs.description: The types given back, and for each `Sender<T>` parameter, `T`. A `Sender<T>` given back is left out.

port.description: A type a flow takes or gives. Unique within its list.

by.description: How the type is taken or given, set by the nearest reference around it. `move`: by value. `read`: by `&`. `mut`: by `&mut`. What crosses a channel is a `move`.

error.description: The type is the error of a `Result`, or `TryFrom`'s `Error`.

channel.description: The values cross a channel: the type was inside a `Sender` or `Receiver`.

hop.description: A name in a module: a step of a re-export's trace, or the type of a flow's port.

module.description: Absolute path of the module holding the name; outside the crate, the path as written.

file.description: `path` of the file defining that module; null if outside the crate.

name.description: Name of the item within that module.
